en: The postcard features a historical scene with a man in a yellow uniform riding a galloping horse along a cobblestone street, raising his hat as if in greeting or announcement. The background includes two people watching by a building gate, a horse-drawn cart, and another man in the distance. The architecture suggests a European setting. In the lower right, a milestone or marker displays an emblem and the year 1776.
